readme.excerpt: Stirling PDF - The Open-Source PDF Platform Stirling PDF is a powerful, open-source PDF editing platform. Run it as a personal desktop app, in the browser, or deploy it on your own servers with a private API. Edit, sign, redact, convert, and automate PDFs without sending documents to external services. Key Capabilities - Everywhere you work - Desktop client, browser UI, and self-hosted server with a private API. - 50+ PDF tools - Edit, merge, split, sign, redact, convert, OCR, compress, and more. - Automation & workflows - No-code pipelines direct in UI with APIs to process millions of PDFs. - Enterprise‑grade - SSO, auditing, and flexible on‑prem deployments. - Developer platform - REST APIs available for nearly all tools to integrate into your existing systems. - Global UI - Interface available in 40+ languages. For a full feature list, see the docs: https://docs.stirlingpdf.com Quick Start Then open: http://localhost:8080 For full installation options (including desktop and Kubernetes), see our Documentation Guide. Resources - Documentation - Homepage - API Docs - Server Plan & Enterprise Support - Community : Discord - Bug Reports : GitHub Issues Contributing We welcome contributions!
